note: Misses on every stated criterion. Occupation is school bus driver plus an as-yet unproductive real estate practice, not business owner or physician; he had a good-paying job and around 20 units once, but lost both. Income fails absolutely — two months without work after eye surgery, 'I don't know how I'm going to make ends meet', and unable to fund even a $200/mo product. Health is not the neglected corner of an otherwise sorted life, it is one of several simultaneous crises alongside grief and financial distress. And he is explicitly the person the exclusion describes: rescue rather than good-to-great ('I just want to get in shape... I can't fit any of my clothes'), unable to squeeze into two closets of clothing, rating his body a 2 out of 10. That the setter booked him and the rep pitched him full price twenty minutes after he disclosed the financial position is a qualification finding, not a judgement on the prospect.
